newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: S&P affirms Toyota Finance NZ CP rating.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms Toyota Finance NZ CP rating.

text.p: Standard and Poor's on Monday affirmed its A-1+ short-term rating to Toyota Finance New Zealand Ltd's increased commercial paper programme.
Bank of New Zealand earlier said Toyota Finance NZ was increasing the size of its New Zealand commercial paper programme to NZ$350 million from $200 million.
The CP programme is guaranteed by Toyota Motor Finance (Netherlands) BV, which benefits from a keepwell agreement provided by Toyota Motor Corporation rated AAA/A-1+.

S&P said Toyota Finance NZ Ltd was an integral part of the Toyota group's presence in New Zealand, providing financing services for authorised Toyota dealers, and retail purchase and lease financing for users of Toyota products such as passenger and commercial vehicles.
